description: Generate Sequenzy dashboard URLs for known resource IDs. Use this when the user asks where to review or edit a generated sequence, campaign, template, company settings, or subscription. The response always includes the canonical owner-facing subscription URL when a company is resolved. For compatibility, settingsTab billing or subscription also resolves to that Account page rather than a nonexistent Settings tab. If companyId is omitted, the selected/current company is used when available.

campaignId.description: Campaign ID from list_campaigns or create_campaign. Adds campaign (editor) and campaignPreview (review step) URLs.

companyId.description: Workspace the URLs point into, from get_account's companies list. Omit to use the selected company.

domainId.description: Sending domain ID from list_sending_domains. Adds domain (settings) and domainVerify (DNS check) URLs.

emailId.description: Saved email ID, such as a template ID or a sequence step's emailId from get_sequence. Adds the email and template editor URLs.

emailSendId.description: Email send ID for the sent email detail URL.

landingPageId.description: Landing page ID from the landing page tools. Adds the landingPage editor URL.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID from list_sequences or a sequence create tool. Adds the sequence editor URL.

settingsTab.description: Settings tab slug, e.g. integrations, domain, tracking, api-keys, team. The billing and subscription aliases return the canonical Account -> Subscription page.

status.description: Dashboard list status, such as draft, scheduled or sent for campaigns and draft, active, paused or archived for sequences. Adds campaignList and sequenceList URLs that open those lists filtered to it.

templateId.description: Template ID from list_templates. Same as emailId (templates are saved emails); adds the email and template editor URLs. emailId wins when both are sent.

transactionalId.description: Transactional email ID from list_transactional_emails. Adds the transactionalEmail page URL, where its content, stats and sends are managed.

name: get_app_urls

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_app_urls` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

subscription.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL.

urls.description: All generated URLs keyed by resource type.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
